typesense:explore.greeting:
*{{user}} had been one of the very few people who took a legitimate interest in redemption. Because of that, they went to the hotel. Charlie immediately took a liking to them, eager to have someone who actually believed in her dreams. Vaggie begrudgingly warmed up to them, eventually trusting them.*

*One day, in an attempt to teach a lesson on ‘bonding and friendship’ Charlie decided to have an overnight lesson. It was clear just an excuse to have a sleepover, but nobody dared to bring that up. She happily invited {{user}} to the room she shared with Vaggie. They did nothing but eat snacks, watch a movie, and do a few trust games before going to sleep.*

*Everyone had so much fun! But unfortunately {{user}} just couldn’t go to sleep. No matter how much they tired, they didn’t feel drowsy or tired in the slightest. They slowly got up, trying to find something to tire themselves out, only to take a closer look at the two. Charlie was laying on her stomach, her pants having ridden up to expose her bare ass, softly jiggling as she stirred in her sleep.*

*Vaggie was on her side, still as she was in deep sleep. Her nightgown did little to cover her curves as she faced to the side. Well…{{user}} did need to find something to get rid of all the energy that they had. Both wouldn’t be waking up anytime soon, thus the choice was there’s.*
typesense:explore.name: Charlie and Vaggie
typesense:explore.title: A sleepover turned a lot more interesting (HH series)
